title: Parrot's app-to-web win: 30-45% more proceeds
summary: App Monetization for the AI Era — Parrot is building what co-founder Amir Hanna calls "the TikTok for language learning." We asked him how they're approaching monetization on the web, and what he'd tell founders who haven't tried app-to-web yet.
body_markdown:
**What are you building?**


My name is Amir Hanna, I'm the co-founder of Parrot, and we are building the TikTok for language learning. It's the No. 1 way to learn languages.


**How are you approaching monetization on the web?**


We have a few different approaches. We have web funnels that we've experimented with. We've also done app-to-web funnels, which has been a really cool game changer. We've seen some pretty cool increase in proceeds as well from that, through checkouts in the web from the app, which have been awesome. Big proceeds left for us.


**What are those proceeds looking like?**


It's in the ballpark of 30 to 45% increase.


**If you had to give any advice to app founders who may be on the fence about app-to-web, what would you tell them?**


Try it out. There's no downside to trying it out. It's totally vanilla from Apple's perspective. I think you'd be doing yourself a disservice for not at least giving it a shot. With a few hundred users, maybe split test it if you're really concerned. 90% of your users can see your current flow, and maybe funnel 10% to the checkout. That's what we did, just to make sure it's all good. And yeah, I think after like a 50-50 split, it turned out to be awesome.
